author: Paperwite
body: hello, I have been banned for many infractions and I was wondering if I could get unbanned. I want to get unbanned because I love this server and I have had many wonderful times on it and made many good friends. Please contact me at scrumb@telus.net and tell me what you can do. THANKS

title: Paperwite ban

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

I'm on the verge of accepting your appeal due to the fact over half of your infractions were in 2014, however they resolve around the two same illegal actions, so I suggest you send another appeal this December/Early 2016 and you might get a chance then, but for now I'm going to to have to say no. ;(
-Denied

Regards,
Auratix,
Senior Moderator.
